definitions.explanation: The property of resisting water penetration or damage from water. Used as a noun or as a modifier (耐水の, 耐水性) to describe materials, products, and coatings that withstand water.

examples.japanese: {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐水|たいすい}⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This watch has a waterproof specification.

examples.japanese: {耐水|たいすい}ペーパー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なめらか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Polishing the finish with waterproof sandpaper makes the surface smooth.

notes:
Composed of {耐|たい} (resistant, enduring) + {水|すい} (water). Part of the productive {耐|たい}〜 pattern for describing resistance to various conditions.

USAGE:
{耐水|たいすい} is commonly used as a compound modifier: {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい} (water resistance as a property), {耐水|たいすい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ (waterproof treatment), {耐水|たいすい}ペーパー (waterproof sandpaper). It is distinct from ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧ (waterproof) in that {耐水|たいすい} emphasizes resistance or durability against water, while ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧ emphasizes preventing water from entering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい}: water resistance (as a property)
- {耐水|たいすい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: waterproofing treatment
- {耐水|たいすい}ペーパー: waterproof sandpaper (wet-dry sandpaper)
- {耐水|たいすい}{圧|あつ}: water pressure resistance rating
- {耐水|たいすい}⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: water-resistant paint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧: waterproof — focuses on blocking water from entering; often used for coatings, cases, and gear
- ⟦{撥水|はっすい}→撥水：16444_hassui⟧: water-repellent — causes water to bead up and roll off the surface
- ⟦{耐熱|たいねつ}→耐熱：21127_tainetsu⟧: heat-resistant — same {耐|たい}〜 pattern applied to heat
- ⟦{耐久|たいきゅう}→耐久：18768_taikyuu⟧: durable — resistance to wear and degradation over time
